shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,100p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; printf '\\n--- package ---\\n'; cat package.json; printf '\\n--- app ---\\n'; sed -n '1,240p' src/App.tsx; printf '\\n--- main ---\\n'; sed -n '1,120p' src/main.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- uikit docs i18n/configure ---'; rg -n -i \"configure\\(|configure.*lang|I18n|lang\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md 2>/dev/null | head -80; printf '%s\\n' '--- i18n package presence ---'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/package.json 2>/dev/null | head -60 || true; printf '%s\\n' '--- uikit d.ts configure ---'; rg -n \"declare function configure|function configure|type Lang|Lang =\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist -g '*.d.ts' | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '78,108p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md; printf '\\n--- i18n docs/types ---\\n'; sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/README.md; printf '\\n--- i18n index types ---\\n'; sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build/esm/index.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build -iname '*select*.d.ts' -o -iname '*select*.js' | head -20; printf '\\n--- exports ---\\n'; rg -n \"export .*Select|declare const Select\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build -g '*.d.ts' | head -40"

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: src/App.tsx
@@
   const languageOptions = [
-    { value: 'en', text: i18n.i18n('language', 'english') },
-    { value: 'ru', text: i18n.i18n('language', 'russian') },
+    { value: 'en' as const, text: i18n.i18n('language', 'english') },
+    { value: 'ru' as const, text: i18n.i18n('language', 'russian') },
   ];
*** End Patch
PATCH
npm run build"

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: src/App.tsx
@@
-  const languageOptions = [
-    { value: 'en', text: i18n.i18n('language', 'english') },
-    { value: 'ru', text: i18n.i18n('language', 'russian') },
-  ];
+  const languageOptions: { value: AppLanguage; text: string }[] = [
+    { value: 'en', text: i18n.i18n('language', 'english') },
+    { value: 'ru', text: i18n.i18n('language', 'russian') },
+  ];
*** End Patch
PATCH

/bin/bash -lc 'command -v apply_patch || true; type -a apply_patch || true; find / -name apply_patch -type f 2>/dev/null | head'

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const fs=require('fs');const p='src/App.tsx';let s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');s=s.replace(\\\"onUpdate={([nextLanguage]) => nextLanguage && setLanguage(nextLanguage)}\\\", \\\"onUpdate={([nextLanguage]) => {\\\\n          if (nextLanguage === 'en' || nextLanguage === 'ru') {\\\\n            setLanguage(nextLanguage);\\\\n          }\\\\n        }}\\\");fs.writeFileSync(p,s)\"; npm run build"
